module rtlpp_03901 (
    areset,
    inclk0,
    c0,
    locked
);

input   areset;
input   inclk0;
output  c0;
output  locked;

tri0    areset;

reg locked_reg;
wire [4:0] clk;
assign c0 = clk[0];
assign locked = locked_reg;

// Dummy signal for configuration inputs
wire [5:0] clk_ena = 6'b111111;
wire [3:0] extclk_ena = 4'b1111;
wire fbin = 1'b1;
wire pfdena = 1'b1;
wire [3:0] phase_counter_select = 4'b1111;
wire phasedone;
wire phase_step = 1'b1;
wire phase_updown = 1'b1;
wire pllena = 1'b1;
wire scan_clr = 1'b0;
wire scan_clk = 1'b0;
wire scan_clkena = 1'b1;
wire scandata = 1'b0;
wire scandataout;
wire scandone;
wire scanread = 1'b0;
wire scanwrite = 1'b0;
wire sclkout0;
wire sclkout1;
wire vcooverrange;
wire vcounderrange;

// PLL Logic (simplified for illustration purposes)
always @(posedge inclk0 or posedge areset)
begin
    if (areset) begin
        locked_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
        // Simple logic to mock PLL locking mechanism
        locked_reg <= 1;
    end
end

assign clk = {4'b0000, inclk0};

endmodule
